AniLife mobile-only preview lint fix — remove legacy site shortcuts and all Android TV launcher signals from mobile APK
Source revision: d868d291f8f80eac8486d9001a2198d561cea622
The previous workflow failed Android lint MissingLeanbackLauncher because the common manifest still advertised android.software.leanback. Move the Leanback uses-feature declaration to app/src/tv/AndroidManifest.xml along with its TV-specific launcher. Mobile manifest now has neither Leanback feature nor launcher, preserving phone/tablet launch compatibility. Settings About and update failure messages no longer link to anilife.cc; required Morphe GPLv3 notice remains.
Do one final :app:testMobileDebugUnitTest :app:lintMobileDebug :app:assembleMobileDebug; validate APK signature. Publish only if all checks pass. Never alter stable release, main, mobile package ID or user data.
